clips.send: If you had to sum up what your country stands for in just twelve words, which would you pick? China did exactly that: 24 Chinese characters making 12 two-character words, called the Core Socialist Values (社会主义核心价值观, shèhuì zhǔyì héxīn jiàzhíguān). You will see them on posters in every Chinese city and school. Where do they come from, and what do they have to do with 5,000 years of culture?
